name: Three Stranded Cord
overview: Scripture reveals the importance of companionship and unity in human relationships, beginning with God's recognition that man should not be alone but needs a suitable helper (Genesis 2:18). Ecclesiastes emphasizes the strength and benefit found in partnership, stating that two working together have a better reward, can provide warmth for one another, and can resist adversity more effectively. The metaphor of a threefold cord illustrates that when three are united, their bond is strong and not easily broken, underscoring the power of mutual support and resilience.
